territorial_scope.description: Applies to elections in which a candidate appears on the state or local ballot, as stated in RSA 664:14-c, II.

evidence.quote: within 90 days of an election at which a candidate for elective office will appear on the ballot

summary.short: New Hampshire statute adding RSA 664:14-c. Effective 1 August 2024, it prohibits persons and entities from distributing AI-created deepfakes of candidates, election officials, or parties within 90 days of an election, unless the media carries a prescribed AI-manipulation disclosure. It gives candidates and election officials injunctive relief and damages actions.
summary.long: Section 345:1 adds RSA 664:14-c, defining synthetic media, AI, generative AI and deepfake. Paragraph II bars any person, corporation, committee or other entity from distributing, within 90 days of an election with a candidate on the ballot, an AI-generated deepfake of a candidate, election official or party on the state or local ballot that it knows or should have known is a deepfake. Paragraph III exempts media carrying a prescribed disclosure that it was manipulated or generated by AI, with size, duration and audio-repetition rules. Paragraph IV allows a depicted candidate or election official to seek injunctive or equitable relief and to sue the sponsor for general or special damages, with prevailing-party attorneys' fees. Paragraph V exempts interactive computer service providers for third-party content, persons without knowledge, bona fide news reports, paid broadcast or platform election communications that keep disclaimers, and satire or parody. Paragraph VI provides severability. Section 345:2 sets the effective date as August 1, 2024. The text states no agency penalty or criminal sanction.

notes: The document has no bill number; the title comes from registry metadata. Section 345:2 and the dateline give an effective date of August 1, 2024, which precedes the approval date of August 2, 2024; both are recorded as written. Section 664:14-c IV(b) refers to 'the sponsor' without defining the term. The text designates no public authority; enforcement is by civil action brought by candidates or election officials (IV). target_instrument_id is empty where the target is not in the registry.

"Synthetic media" means an image, an audio recording, or a video recording of an individual's appearance, speech, or conduct
"Artificial intelligence" or "AI" is the ability of a machine to display human-like capabilities for cognitive tasks such as reasoning, learning, planning, and creativity.
"Generative AI" is AI that can generate text, images, or other media in response to prompts.
"Deepfake" means a video, audio, or any other media of a person in which his or her face, body, or voice has been digitally altered
An interactive computer service provider as defined in 47 U.S.C. section 230 for content provided by another party.

obligations.summary: Any person, corporation, committee or other entity may not, within 90 days of an election with a candidate on the ballot, distribute AI-created or generative AI messages that it knows or should have known are deepfakes of a candidate, election official or party on the state or local ballot.
obligations.conditional_on: Within 90 days of an election at which a candidate for elective office will appear on the ballot; subject to the exception in paragraph III and the exclusions in paragraph V.

evidence.quote: a person, corporation, committee, or other entity shall not, within 90 days of an election at which a candidate for elective office will appear on the ballot, distribute a message created using artificial intelligence or generative AI

obligations.summary: To fall outside the prohibition, the audio or visual media must include the disclosure stating it was manipulated or generated by AI and depicts speech or conduct that did not occur, with the blank filled as image, video or audio. Visual media: text size readable by the average viewer, no smaller than the largest other text, shown for the full duration of video. Audio-only: read clearly, audible, at the beginning and end and at intervals of no more than 2 minutes if longer than 2 minutes.
obligations.conditional_on: Applies only where the person seeks the exception from the prohibition in paragraph II.
